summary: classNames.historyBackdrop sets a class on the backdrop of the full-screen chat drawer; the drawer states (data-drawer="true", hidden, role="dialog") are documented as stable.
howTo: Optional: classNames={{ historyBackdrop: 'my-backdrop' }}. The shipped backdrop color comes from a (0,2,0) rule, so a single class does not override it: use .my-backdrop.my-backdrop or [data-element="history-backdrop"].my-backdrop after styles.css, or unstyled; existing CSS on [data-element="history-backdrop"] keeps working. Select the drawer with [data-element="history"][data-drawer], the open one with :not([hidden]); aria-expanded on [data-action="history"] holds for the built-in toggle (a renderButton sets its own). A renderButton that opens a tooltip on focus shows it when focus returns to the chats toggle after the drawer closes; open it on :focus-visible or hover only. See placing-the-assistant.md, Replacing shell parts.
